newsitem.title: USA: Champion to buy back 2.5 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Champion to buy back 2.5 million shares.

text.p: Champion Enterprises Inc said Tuesday its board of directors has authorized a common stock repurchase program for up to 2.5 million shares of its 48.4 million shares outstanding.

Timing of the program, which begins immediately, will be determined by financial and market conditions. Goldman, Sachs & Co. will be managing the program through open market or privately negotiated transactions.

Jacqueline Dout, chief financial officer, told shareholders at the company's annual meeting that Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Walter Young was not present because of an angioplasty procedure. He is expected to be released from the hospital Tuesday and return to work later this week.
Dout said Champion plans to spend up to $45 million on capital expenditures in 1997. In addition to two Indiana facilities opened in January, six new plants are planned to open in 1997.
"The slow start in manufactured housing industry shipments this year has not tempered our optimism for future growth opportunities for Champion," she said.
Champion makes manufactured homes and medium-duty buses.
